title: State Renaming of a Word Configuration
statement: Let $f$ map a state set $S_1$ to a state set $S_3$, let $q\in S_1$, and let $w$ be a family of $k$ Boolean words. Renaming the state of the word configuration for $q$ and $w$ by $f$ gives the word configuration for $f(q)$ and $w$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a function from S₁ to S₃
q is a state in S₁
w is a family of k Boolean words
